e019237c68.q: What was Buckby Electrical featured on and how did that opportunity impact the business?
e019237c68.a: Buckby Electrical was featured on The Block Glass House, a television show that was in its final weeks at the time of this interview. Sam was recommended by an architect and a local builder connected to the show hosts Shannon and Simon. The experience was one of the most enjoyable jobs for Sam due to the high level of trust the clients placed in his expertise, allowing for consultative work rather than strict directive-based projects. The job required working long hours, often until midnight, and demonstrated the trust and holistic service his team could deliver.

214874b571.q: What challenges arise when contractors follow strict project specifications rather than providing expert recommendations?
214874b571.a: When working under strict directives with 100-page specifications, contractors often see things that won't work or won't satisfy the customer, but lack the opportunity to fix them because they are bound by contract. Sam noted this frustration happens all too often over his 15+ years in the industry, and it can sometimes cost the customer in the end because they discover the solution is not what they actually wanted.
